quiz.question_id: Apa yang dimaksud dengan 'promoted method' dalam struct embedding?
quiz.question_en: What does 'promoted method' mean in struct embedding?
options_id: Method yang tidak bisa diakses dari luar package
Method dari tipe yang di-embed yang bisa dipanggil langsung dari tipe luar
Method yang hanya ada di tipe luar
options_en: A method that cannot be accessed from outside the package
A method from the embedded type that can be called directly on the outer type
A method that only exists on the outer type

quiz.question_id: Apakah embedding di Go sama dengan inheritance di Java/C#?
quiz.question_en: Is embedding in Go the same as inheritance in Java/C#?
options_id: Tidak, embedding adalah komposisi. Dog yang embed Animal bukan subtype dari Animal
options_en: Yes, they are exactly the same
No, embedding is composition. A Dog that embeds Animal is not a subtype of Animal

quiz.question_id: Jika `Dog` meng-embed `Animal` dan keduanya memiliki method `Eat()`, method mana yang dipanggil dengan `dog.Eat()`?
quiz.question_en: If `Dog` embeds `Animal` and both have an `Eat()` method, which method is called with `dog.Eat()`?
options_id: Method dari Dog — method luar meng-shadow method embedded
options_en: Dog's method — the outer method shadows the embedded method
